message.jobless_reincarnation_dev.roxy_t: First study the Water Ball Tome to learn Water Ball, then come back and show me your practice.
Successful Water Ball casts: %s/%s. Keep practising with your Apprentice Wand in Survival mode, then speak to me again.
Qualifying target hits: %s/%s. In Survival mode, cast Water Ball and hit a target block from at least %s blocks away, measured from where you released it.
Next, keep charging after the chant until it reads Fully shaped, then release and hit a target block from at least %s blocks away in Survival mode.
You have met the water magic practice goals. Claim your Water Magic Practice Card at the Water Magic Training Board.
You have already claimed your Water Magic Practice Card. You can keep practising with the Apprentice Wand and targets.
